result.summary: Step 2 design artefact written to src/design/iss0187-store-append-lease-discipline.md. Fix shape: 4-line edit at src/event_store/store.zig (drop dup_conn acquire/release at lines 449-451; rename two dup_conn.query to conn.query). The held conn has been ROLLBACK\u2019d at line 435 so it is no longer in any transaction, making it safe to reuse for read-only SELECTs. No public API change; no migration; no error-set change. Full audit of all 6 acquire sites (lines 277, 555, 662, 720, 891, 951) shows no other store.zig path nests acquire inside a held lease. Test plan covers TC-EXP-301-08 (existing) plus a new regression test for duplicate-append under pool saturation. Routing to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 2b).
